mapper.select: SELECT r.approval_id AS approvalId, r.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, r.revision_no AS revisionNo, r.status AS status, r.title AS title, r.content AS content FROM approval_revision r WHERE r.approval_id IN #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.revision_no = ( SELECT MAX(r2.revision_no) FROM approval_revision r2 WHERE r2.approval_id = r.approval_id AND r2.deleted_at IS NULL )
SELECT approval_revision_id AS revisionId, status AS status FROM approval_line WHERE approval_revision_id IN #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
